dialogue.content: 本日は宜しくお願いいたします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for being here today. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは初めに年齢と性別、お話ししたい事を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 48歳女性です。最近、体調がすぐれず何もする気が起こらない状態が続いていて、なんとかしたいと思ってるのですが、、しんどい毎日です
dialogue.English: I'm a 48-year-old woman. Lately, I've been feeling unwell and have had no motivation to do anything. It's been ongoing, and while I want to do something about it, every day is just exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね教えていただいてありがとうございます。体調がすぐれないとのことですが詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me. You mentioned you haven't been feeling well. Could you tell me more about that?

dialogue.content: とにかく朝起きるのが辛くて、、頑張って起き上がる毎日です。
dialogue.English: It's just so hard to get up in the morning... I have to force myself to get out of bed every day.

dialogue.content: それが毎日続くとしんどいですね、、お仕事はされているんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must be very draining when it's every day. Are you currently working?

dialogue.content: はい。会社勤めではないですが、仕事はしていて、写真などを使ったアルバム作りを教えています
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't work for a company, but I do have a job. I teach how to make albums using photos and other materials.

dialogue.content: 素敵なお仕事ですね朝、しんどい中頑張って起きてお仕事や家事などをされているんですね
dialogue.English: That sounds like a wonderful job. So, despite feeling unwell in the mornings, you're pushing yourself to get up and handle work and household chores.

dialogue.content: そうですね。今年は子どもの高校入学もあって準備も重なっていて、、いつも以上に忙しいです
dialogue.English: Yes. This year my child is starting high school, so there's been a lot of preparation on top of everything... I'm busier than usual.

dialogue.content: 高校生のお子様がいらっしゃるんですね他にご家族はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: So you have a child in high school. Do you have any other family members?

dialogue.content: 主人と中学生の娘がいます
dialogue.English: I have a husband and a daughter in junior high school.

dialogue.content: 毎日頑張っていらっしゃるんですねご家族と体調についてお話されていますか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're working so hard every day. Have you talked to your family about how you've been feeling?

dialogue.content: はい、伝えているので気にかけてはくれます。娘たちも手伝ってくれたりします
dialogue.English: Yes, I've told them, so they are concerned about me. My daughters help out, too.

dialogue.content: お母様思いのご家族なんですね体調が早良くなって安心させてあげたいとお考えかなと思います。病院などでご相談はされましたか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have a very considerate family. I imagine you want to get better soon to put their minds at ease. Have you consulted with a doctor?

dialogue.content: 受診して、お薬ももらって飲んでいますが、今ひとつ良くならなくて。体調が何も変わらないんです
dialogue.English: I have seen a doctor and I'm taking the medication I was prescribed, but it's not really helping. My condition hasn't changed at all.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねそれは不安になってしまいますねお薬以外、お医者様からお勧めされたことなどはあるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. That would understandably make you anxious. Did your doctor recommend anything besides medication?

dialogue.content: これと言って特には、、もともと、喘息の持病もあってその調子も良くなくて。やりたいこともできない毎日です
dialogue.English: Not particularly... I also have chronic asthma, and that hasn't been doing well either. Every day, I can't do the things I want to do.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかとてももどかしい日々お過ごしなんですねちなみにやりたい事とはどんな事でしょう
dialogue.English: I see. You must be spending your days feeling very frustrated. By the way, what kind of things would you like to do?

dialogue.content: なにか特別にやりたいことがあるわけではないですが、普通にやりたいと思ったことをやれるようになりたいです。
dialogue.English: It's not that I have anything special I want to do; I just want to be able to do the ordinary things I feel like doing.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか先ほどお仕事の事を伺ったとき、楽しそうなお仕事だなと思いましたがお仕事されている時は体調はいかがでしょう
dialogue.English: I see. When you mentioned your work earlier, it sounded like a very enjoyable job. How do you feel when you're working?

dialogue.content: しんどいのは変わりないですね
dialogue.English: It's still tough; that hasn't changed.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、しんどい中お仕事も続けていらっしゃるんですね体調がすぐれない中、お仕事を続けてこられたのはどういった思いからでしょうか
dialogue.English: I understand... You've continued working despite feeling unwell. What has motivated you to keep working in this condition?

dialogue.content: お仕事自体が好きだからですね
dialogue.English: It's because I genuinely like the work itself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれは素敵なことですねどういったところが楽しいのか教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: I see—that's wonderful. Could you tell me what aspects you enjoy?

dialogue.content: 細かい作業が、とても多いですが出来上がった時の達成感と喜ぶお客様の表情がとても嬉しいと思います
dialogue.English: There's a lot of detailed work, but the sense of accomplishment when it's finished and seeing the happy expressions on my customers' faces makes me very happy.

dialogue.content: なるほど人を喜ばせるお仕事なんですね手先も器用なかたなのでしょうかやりがいあるお仕事をされているんですね
dialogue.English: I see—it's work that brings joy to others. You must be quite skillful with your hands. It sounds very rewarding.

dialogue.content: やりがいはあると思いますが、、今は体がしんどいので思うようにできないのが辛いです
dialogue.English: I do find it rewarding, but right now my body feels so run-down that it's hard to do things the way I'd like, and that's painful.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよねお薬が効果を実感できず、持病もお持ちななか、子育てもお忙しく、お仕事もされているんですねとても頑張っていらっしゃると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, that makes sense. The medication isn't having an effect, you're managing a chronic illness, you're busy raising children, and you're working as well—I think you're doing your very best.

dialogue.content: お仕事などを少しセーブされることなんかはお考えにありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you considered easing up a bit on work and other commitments?

dialogue.content: 仕事をセーブすることはできますが、これ以上なにもできなくなるのは嫌です
dialogue.English: I could cut back on work, but I don't want to end up being able to do even less.

dialogue.content: そういったご不安があったんですねゆっくりしてしまうともっと何もできなくなるとお感じなんですね？
dialogue.English: So that's a concern for you—you feel that if you slow down, you'll be able to do even less, is that right?

dialogue.content: 体調が悪く前ほどできなくなって、これ以上できなくなったら、、、早く前みたいに戻りたいです。
dialogue.English: My health has worsened and I can't do as much as before; if I become able to do even less... I just want to get back to how I was as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: 心配になってしまうのは当然だと思います。当たり前にできていたことができなくなるというのは辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I think it's natural to feel worried. It must be painful when you can no longer do the things you used to take for granted.

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お医者様にお薬が効かないことは伝えられましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you told your doctor that the medication isn't working?

dialogue.content: 伝えましたが、、特には、、
dialogue.English: I told them, but nothing really changed.

dialogue.content: 変わらずなんですね、、例えばセカンドオピニオンとい事は考えられましたか？
dialogue.English: So nothing has changed... Have you, for example, considered getting a second opinion?

dialogue.content: いえ、、前から通っているかかりつけ医なので。考えてないです
dialogue.English: No... It's my long-time primary doctor, so I haven't considered it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねでは、アロマやハーブティーを試されたことはありますか？心を落ち着かせたり眠りにいい作用があります。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, have you ever tried aromatherapy or herbal tea? They can have a calming effect and help with sleep.

dialogue.content: はい、お友達に頂いたりして色々試してはいます。
dialogue.English: Yes, friends have given me some, and I've been trying various things.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかその時はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How was it when you tried them?

dialogue.content: なんとなく良いかなぁと思いました。
dialogue.English: I felt they were kind of helpful, I guess.

dialogue.content: 自分なりに色々やってみてはいるのですが、これぞといって改善もなく
dialogue.English: I've been trying various things in my own way, but nothing has led to clear improvement.

dialogue.content: ずっとこのままなのかなぁ、、と思うまた落ち込みます
dialogue.English: I wonder if I'll be like this forever... and thinking that makes me feel down again.

dialogue.content: そうですか強い作用があるわけではないかもしれませんがなんとなく良かったものなんかを続けてみるのもいいかもしれませんご不安は当然だと思います、でも心や体を休める時間を勇気をもってとることも大切かもしれません
dialogue.English: I see. They may not have strong effects, but it might be good to keep up with the things that felt even slightly helpful. Your worries are understandable, but it may also be important to have the courage to set aside time to rest your mind and body.

dialogue.content: そうですかね、、、
dialogue.English: Do you think so...?

dialogue.content: とても素敵なご家族とお仕事とご友人をお持ちだと感じました。体調の悪い時はもっと自分を甘やかすこともいいと感じました
dialogue.English: I feel you have a wonderful family, work, and friends. When you're not feeling well, it can be good to be more gentle with yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、、そうしてみます。
dialogue.English: Yes... I'll try to do that.

dialogue.content: 本日はお時間が来てしまいました。体調すぐれない中、ご相談にきていただいてありがとうございました。また是非お話しに来てください
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up for today. Thank you for coming to talk with me, especially when you're not feeling well. Please feel free to come and talk again.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 終了のメッセージが流れます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: The closing message will now play. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。時間、オーバーしてしまい申し訳ございません。お手数ですがフィードバックお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I'm sorry for going over time. I would appreciate it if you could provide feedback.)
